### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #31933

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

#30943 allows TiDB read by TiKV's RC but with a wrong implementation. This PR merges the RC usage into `SetFromSessionVars` and fix the issue that the weak-consistency read does not work.

issue_context.title: Weak read consistency cannot take effect
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
Enable weak read consistency (`set @@tidb_read_consistency = weak`) and execute some queries.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/30943 set the isolation under some conditions, however the field will be overwritten by `SetFromSessionVars`.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
The [isolation field](https://github.com/pingcap/kvproto/blob/805ac3a35f883d87bf1fe70480ef5a7b9e64cd8f/proto/kvrpcpb.proto#L675) of rpc requests should be `RC`.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
It's still `SI`

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master, release-5.4
comments:
A possible way to fix this is to merge the 
```
if e.ctx.GetSessionVars().StmtCtx.WeakConsistency {
		builder.SetIsolationLevel(kv.RC)
}
```
logic into 
`SetFromSessionVars`, so there would be a single entry setting `stmtCtx` related things.
Please check whether the issue should be labeled with 'affects-x.y' or 'fixes-x.y.z', and then remove 'needs-more-info' label.
